integrity: All numerical assertions arise from exhaustive finite enumeration with two independent cycle constructions, two closed-word predicates and a first-return enumeration; a mathematical proof supplies the all-order bound. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The four-cell circular closed-factor distribution is proved only for binary order-five de Bruijn cycles. The general upper bound is not asserted sharp. Historical priority cannot be established solely from targeted searches.
title: Closed-factor rigidity of binary de Bruijn cycles
